stories.title: Heavy rains, storm surge, high tides cause ‘real drama’ along B.C.’s coast
stories.summary: British Columbia's coast is getting another weather wallop as Environment Canada warns of rain of up to 225 millimetres along much of the coast before the end of the day.

stories.title: Doctor slams Island Health after woman dies outside closed emergency room
stories.summary: A shortage of emergency-trained nurses at Port Hardy Hospital is raising concerns, with one critic saying nurse managers should return to front-line care to help keep the ER open.

stories.title: Kelowna foster care village aims to tackle declining number of foster homes
stories.summary: A $15-million project is aiming to create a purpose-built community for foster kids, as high housing costs are making it difficult to place children.

stories.title: Court filing claims RCMP allegedly returned gun later used in Tumbler Ridge shooting
stories.summary: U.S. authorities have already released months of alleged online correspondence between James Cody Bryant and B.C. teenager Jesse Van Rootselaar.

stories.title: ‘We are all in this together’: Vancouver police target dangerous road behaviour
stories.summary: A morning ride-along with Vancouver police showed just how quickly routine traffic enforcement can escalate from a speeding ticket to a vehicle impoundment.

stories.title: Woman who died in Squamish boating tragedy loved life, animals, family says
stories.summary: Friends say Femke Visser, a local horse guide and dogsled guide, had gone out with neighbours to help animals and people stranded by the floodwater.

stories.title: California man ticketed for going 208 km/h on Sea-to-Sky Highway
stories.summary: The 22-year-old was pulled over in his BMW earlier this month near Squamish after he was recorded going 208 kilometres in a 90 km/h zone.

stories.title: Coastal B.C. bracing for another fall storm as warnings issued, King Tides expected
stories.summary: Another frontal system is washing over coastal B.C., bringing heavy rains and strong winds, swelling waterways just as king tides peak this week.

stories.title: Author Galloway’s lawyer asks B.C. court for millions in defamation award
stories.summary: The lawyer for author and former UBC professor Steven Galloway says his client's accuser started rape allegations and encouraged others to spread the claims.

stories.title: Mortgage delinquency rate up 31% in Q3, driven by Ontario and B.C.: Equifax report
stories.summary: A new report suggests there's growing stress among homeowners, with some struggling to keep up with monthly mortgage payments as interest rates rise again.
